text:
incident-bot: Paging oncall: HIGH error rate observed for /batch/embed-rerank (500s) — alert: embed-rerank-5xx-rate > 5% for 5m :rotating_light:
eng-oncall: acked — I'm on it, looking now.
sara-nguyen: I can help triage, seeing downstream 500s in the logs too. Impacting nightly batch jobs and a handful of customer requests.
mike-chen: any customer-mostly impact? which customers are hitting batch endpoints now?
jay-patel: Customer A ran a large rerank job ~00:12 UTC, a lot of items failed with "vector length mismatch" in the python worker logs.
olivia-mason: confirmed — dashboards show a spike at 00:11:45 UTC, latency + errors. I'll pull the trace IDs.
eng-oncall: timeline so far: 00:11:20 - first 5xx spike; 00:12:00 - bulk batch job kicked; 00:12:10 - error spike peaks. Looks correlated.
sara-nguyen: sharing logs: `gs://redwood-logs/prod/embed-rerank/2026-03-15/00/*.jsonl` — I tailed one file, excerpt below:
```
ERROR rerank_worker.py:got vector of length 1536, expected 1024
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/rerank/rerank_worker.py", line 142, in process_batch
    embeddings = deserialize_vectors(payload)
  File "/srv/rerank/serialize.py", line 78, in deserialize_vectors
    raise ValueError(f"vector len {len(v)} != {expected}")
```

mike-chen: that smells like a model variant mismatch — some requests encoded 1536-dim vectors (maybe a different encoder). Any recent deploys to embedder?
jay-patel: Deploys: embedder-serving rolled a canary at 23:58 UTC last night to v2.3-quant, but the reranker hasn't been pinned and accepts any vector length.
olivia-mason: I see routing rules: hosted API routes `embedder:v2.3-quant` to batch pool A and `embedder:v2.2` still on pool B. Could a mixed pool send to reranker with different vector sizes?
eng-oncall: hypothesis 1: mixed model versions produced heterogeneous vector dims; reranker expects fixed dim=1024 -> throws on deserialize.
sara-nguyen: hypothesis 2: serialization change in v2.3-quant (different dtype/packing) caused length to appear as 1536 after decoding. Need sample payloads.
mike-chen: grabbing offending payload: `gcloud storage cp gs://redwood-logs/prod/embed-rerank/2026-03-15/00/payload_00ab.json .` — uploaded to thread: https://internal.redwood/logs/1950012345/payload_00ab.json
jay-patel: looked at payload: header says "model: embedder-v2.3-quant", vector count 512 length 3 -> flattened length 1536. So indeed 3*512 =1536. Reranker code expects vectors shaped (512,1024) previously.
olivia-mason: quick mitigation: we can add a tolerant deserializer to handle variable lengths and pad/truncate to 1024 for live traffic. Risk: quality regression for customers. Thoughts?
eng-oncall: mitigation plan options:
- short term: reject 1536 vectors with 400 and return explanation -> avoids crashes but induces customer errors (bad UX).
- mid term: runtime adapter that truncates/pads silently -> keeps availability but may affect rank quality.
- roll back embedder canary -> forces homogeneous vectors (if we believe v2.3 is culprit).
sara-nguyen: rollback safe? Who owns embedder deploys? @mike-chen did the canary.
mike-chen: I can roll v2.3 out of traffic to 0% in the routing config in ~3m. Pros: likely restores stability. Cons: loses perf/quantization gains.
jay-patel: while rolling back, let's also add a quick guard in reranker that logs vector lengths and DROPS only when necessary — non-blocking patch. I can ship a hotfix to the reranker pool (python change to `deserialize_vectors` to check length and pad/truncate).
olivia-mason: customer impact note: Customer A saw ~40% of their batch fail (errors returned) between 00:12 — 00:22 UTC. We need to notify CS/SEs and offer to re-run after mitigation.
eng-oncall: action items (live):
1) Mike roll back embedder canary -> Mike
2) Jay prepare reranker patch (len check + metrics) -> Jay
3) Sara handle customer comms + collect failed job IDs -> Sara
4) Olivia capture full timeline + upload traces -> Olivia
5) Eng-oncall monitor for 10m -> Eng-oncall
mike-chen: starting rollback now. updating routing to pin all traffic to v2.2. Will post when complete.
(3m later)
mike-chen: rollback done at 00:17:05 UTC, routing shows 100% to v2.2.
eng-oncall: monitoring — error rate dropped to 0.6% at 00:18:10 and back to baseline 0.1% by 00:20:00.
jay-patel: hotfix pushed to reranker staging, test shows graceful handling of 1536 vectors by truncation+metric log. Pushing to prod pool B now.
sara-nguyen: CS pinged Customer A with summary and offered re-run. They accepted and will queue a re-run for 02:00 UTC.
olivia-mason: uploaded full timeline and logs: `https://internal.redwood/incidents/1950012345/timeline.json` and a short clip of the anomaly in metrics.
mike-chen: root cause hypothesis (for RCA): embedder v2.3-quant changed embedding configuration (new pipeline that emits 1536-length vectors for better downstream perf) but routing allowed mixed versions to feed the reranker which assumed fixed 1024. No contract enforced between components.
sara-nguyen: contributing factor: lack of schema/shape validation at RPC boundary; deserializer raised ValueError and bubbled up as 500.
jay-patel: next steps for RCA:
- collect all payload samples (done)
- confirm embedder changes (PR diff + release notes) -> Mike
- add shape validation + defensive adapter in reranker -> Jay (shipping patch)
- define contract: model-output-schema in catalog + pre-flight checks in batch router -> Product/Platform follow-up (I'll write a ticket)
eng-oncall: customer impact summary to include in incident report: Customer A 40% job failures between 00:12-00:22 UTC, total 12k items affected; other customers saw transient 5xx spikes but no lasting data loss.
olivia-mason: handing off to next oncall for RCA writeup. Next oncall: @sara-nguyen will coordinate postmortem doc and timelines.
sara-nguyen: taking handoff — I'll compile timeline, attach logs, and track mitigations + longterm fixes. I'll publish a draft postmortem in 6 hours and loop in SEs for customer follow-up.
incident-bot: Incident incident-1950012345 transitioned to INVESTIGATING -> RESOLVED (severity lowered) at 00:25:00 UTC.
eng-oncall: closing notes: rollout rollback + reranker patch combined to restore service. Root cause pending confirmation of embedder config diff. Will update RCA when PRs and tickets exist. Thanks all. :raised_hands:
